title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: When a kid speaks up
hook: A player tells you something does not feel right.
intro: It might be something a teammate said.
statement: Kids keep telling adults who listen the first time.
q1: Do you stop and listen right away —
q2: or note it and follow up after practice?
q3: What happens if you brush it off?
t1: Every situation is different. But kids speak up
t2: when they know an adult will take them seriously.
ctaLines: Stop and listen. Follow up after. Tell the parent.
ctaPrompt: Share your approach below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player tells you something does not feel right.
It might be their knee. It might be something a teammate said.
Kids keep telling adults who listen the first time.
Listen right away or follow up after. There is no perfect answer.
How do you respond? Share your habit in the comments.
